method: Human semantic reading by Codex of every question part and its case context; ordered entries correspond to question-parts-draft.json for each source. No token-matching first pass was used. Values identify the syllabus topic and its numbered specific-objective bullet, not a final decomposed registry. + records secondary links; the first is primary for mark-share totals.
